title: Set-Aside Accounts Plan Matrix: Entry Conditions, Sizing Basis and Holding Limits
content:
Set-Aside Accounts are set up at closing under one of six plans. Each plan has its own entry condition, its own basis for the amount reserved, and its own limits.

## Entry conditions

| Plan | Loan program | Entry condition at closing |
|---|---|---|
| Fully Funded LESA (Mandatory) | HECM | The financial assessment result requires a fully funded LESA |
| Fully Funded LESA (Borrower-Elected) | HECM | The financial assessment result does not require a LESA, and the borrower signed an election for one |
| Partially Funded LESA | HECM | The financial assessment result requires a partially funded LESA |
| Repair Set-Aside | HECM | The appraisal requires repairs, and the repair estimate is at most 15.0 percent of the maximum claim amount |
| Servicing Fee Set-Aside | HECM | The servicing fee option chosen is a monthly fee with a set-aside |
| Summit Tax and Insurance Reserve | Cedarline Summit | A reserve is required or elected |

## Sizing basis and limits

| Plan | Imposed by the financial assessment (not elected) | Computed to the age of the youngest borrower or eligible non-borrowing spouse (years) | Months of property charges funded into the reserve at closing | Loan programs it can attach to | Largest number of open set-asides of this plan on one loan | Borrower may deposit additional funds |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Fully Funded LESA (Mandatory) | Yes | 100 | 0 | HECM | 1 | No |
| Fully Funded LESA (Borrower-Elected) | No | 100 | 0 | HECM | 1 | No |
| Partially Funded LESA | Yes | 100 | 0 | HECM | 1 | No |
| Repair Set-Aside | No | 0 (not computed actuarially) | 0 | HECM | 1 | No |
| Servicing Fee Set-Aside | No | 100 | 0 | HECM | 1 | No |
| Summit Tax and Insurance Reserve | No | 0 (not computed actuarially) | 24 | Cedarline Summit | 1 | Yes |

## Points of reading

- A computation age of 0 means the amount is not computed actuarially; a months figure of 0 means the plan is not a fixed-months reserve. The Summit Tax and Insurance Reserve is the only fixed-months reserve, holding 24 months of property charges at closing.
- HECM plans attach only to a HECM loan; the Summit Tax and Insurance Reserve attaches only to a Cedarline Summit loan.
- The Summit Tax and Insurance Reserve is the only plan whose balance can be added to by a borrower deposit after closing.
- The limit of 1 counts open set-asides of the same plan on the same loan; different plans may sit on one loan side by side.
